title: Sync to live shows once its switch is on: a bundle copy of ui-switches first asked late starts from the page's /api/ui answer (one read for every copy, no defaults written back onto <html>), the ••• menu's Sync rows follow the switches, and the row lands on the Publish tab's Sync to live flow (Review › Send); Will add shows a new record's kind, not its columns
expect: S1: a module copy created after another copy's /api/ui answer reads site-sync-to-live true at once, writes the answer (not the defaults) on <html data-tracy-hide>, and the page makes one /api/ui read; a copy created while the read is on its way joins it and hears it land
S1: the ••• menu drawn before the door answers gains the Sync to live row when the answer says it is on; an Editor never gets either Sync row

S1: the menu's landing opens the Publish tab on kind live, step push; Review lists the groups with removals and PHP unticked, Will add names a new record and its kind without its columns while Will change names the changed fields, Continue goes to Send, Confirm posts {deletes:false, php:false}, Back returns with nothing sent; running phases show their stages and no dead button; pushed shows the result and Undo asks once more
fence: an operator's switch that is off by default shows wherever /api/ui says it is on, in every plugin's copy of the module

tests: a bundle copy first asked after the door answered reads the answer at once
Sync to live, off by default, appears in a menu drawn before the door said
an Editor never gets the Sync rows
the ••• menu lands on Sync to live
Confirm’s Back returns to the groups
pushed: what reached the live site
